issues.body: The document still records a provably terminating huge ACIR loop that can hang without a diagnostic, two ACIR bailout paths that discard source locations, a stale mem2reg ordering comment, and a changelog overclaim. Section 6 explains why unmeasured optimization hypotheses were not promoted to beads, but these four findings are independent correctness, diagnostics, and documentation work and remain without durable task-graph references. This is materially the same major issue reported in round 1.
issues.fix_hint: Create appropriately scoped bead(s) for these four independent follow-ups and cite their IDs at the relevant findings, or explicitly establish that each is non-actionable and remove its future-work framing. Keep the eight optimization candidate specs gated on measurement as currently documented.
issues.title: Independent actionable findings remain untracked

verdict.summary: Round 2 is stagnant. The prior major finding remains: the new research record still identifies actionable independent follow-ups (the runaway-unroll hang, two lost source locations, the stale mem2reg ordering comment, and the changelog overclaim) without citing durable bead IDs or removing them as non-actionable. The explicit decision not to create beads is justified only for the eight unmeasured optimization candidates whose promotion gate was not met; it does not cover these separate correctness, diagnostics, and documentation findings. Under the repository's task-tracking contract, leaving those findings solely in Markdown is incomplete.
